_comment: Region dimensions are in TILES, and one tile is roughly one metre — dungeon corridors are a
tile wide and the hero's radius is 0.35. Sizes are therefore derived from Starting Region.md's
own geography rather than picked: a walled town core, plus the spec's ~100m cleared band on
every side (200 tiles per axis before a single wall), plus the forest fringe beyond it.
Owner ruling 2026-08-06: keep 1m tiles and let regions be genuinely large.
regionWidth/regionHeight/population/forestDepth are consumed by the region generator (PR 6);
the hostility profile below is live now.
